svg.title: Pip Hybrid
svg.desc: A friendly asymmetrical ink pebble with two light eyes looking slightly to the right.
svg.metadata: Original hand-authored Pip Hybrid artwork, 2026-10-23. Licensed under the MIT License. Copyright (c) 2026 Pip Hybrid contributors. This silhouette is also implemented by PipPebble in PipGeometry.swift. No external mascot geometry, motion engine, font or embedded resource is used.
